title: Uko Wakuramo Videwo n'Amafoto bya Pinterest muri Gallery
description: Kuramo ku buntu videwo n'amafoto bya Pinterest ubibike muri Gallery ya telefoni cyangwa kuri mudasobwa, nta app kandi nta kwinjira. Kurikiza izi ntambwe.
body:
Wigeze ubona kuri Pinterest videwo y'uburyo bwo guteka, igitekerezo cyo gutaka inzu, cyangwa isomo rigufi maze ukifuza kongera kuyireba nta interineti? Uburyo bwo kubika bwa Pinterest bushyira Pin ku kibaho (board) imbere muri app gusa, bityo dosiye ntijya koko muri Gallery ya telefoni yawe. Muri iyi nyandiko uriga uko wakuramo videwo za Pinterest n'amafoto ya Pinterest ukabibika muri Gallery mu buryo bworoshye, ku buntu, nta yindi app kandi nta kwinjira.

Igikoresho tugiye gukoresha ni I Need Save, igikoresho cyo gukuramo gikorera kuri interineti ushobora gufungura ako kanya muri mushakisha, kuri telefoni cyangwa kuri mudasobwa. Uretse Pinterest, I Need Save ikora no ku nyandiko rusange za TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter) n'izindi mbuga nke.

Ibyo Ukeneye Gutegura

  • Link ya Pin ushaka kubika. Reba neza ko iyo Pin ari rusange.
  • Mushakisha iyo ari yo yose, urugero Chrome kuri Android cyangwa Safari kuri iPhone.
  • Interineti ihamye bihagije, cyane cyane ku videwo ndende.

Ntukeneye gufungura konti kuri I Need Save kandi ntukeneye gushyiramo app n'imwe.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za Pinterest kuri Telefoni

Intambwe ni zimwe kuri Android no kuri iPhone:

  1. Fungura app ya Pinterest maze ushake Pin ya videwo ushaka.
  2. Kanda buto ya Sangiza (Share), hanyuma uhitemo Koporora link (Copy link).
  3. Fungura mushakisha maze ujye ku rupapuro rwo gukuramo rwa I Need Save.
  4. Omeka link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande gusa buto ya Omeka.
  5. Kanda Kuramo maze utegereze gato kugeza amahitamo y'amadosiye agaragaye.
  6. Hitamo ihitamo wifuza, urugero videwo y'ubwiza runaka.

Niba buto ihindutse ikandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…, ntufunge urupapuro. Bisobanura ko videwo irimo gutunganywa, urugero amashusho n'amajwi birimo guhuzwa cyangwa stream irimo guhindurwa MP4. Nibirangira, gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo.

Uko Wabika Amafoto ya Pinterest

Kuri Pin z'amafoto, uburyo ni bumwe hafi ya byose. Koporora link ya Pin, uyomeke kuri I Need Save, hanyuma ukande Kuramo. Ku rutonde rw'amahitamo, hitamo Ifoto cyangwa Ifoto ntoya. Iri hitamo rifite akamaro kandi niba ukeneye gusa ishusho y'igifuniko cya Pin ya videwo, urugero yo kwifashisha mu mushinga wawe bwite wo gushushanya.

Guhitamo Ubwiza bwa Videwo Bukwiye

Numara gukanda Kuramo, akenshi urabona ubwiza butandukanye nka 360p, 720p cyangwa 1080p. Amahitamo agaragara aterwa na videwo y'umwimerere, bityo si Pin zose zifite 1080p.

  • 360p ikwiye niba ipaki ya interineti ari nke cyangwa ububiko bwa telefoni bwenda kuzura.
  • 720p ni ihitamo riringaniza ubwiza bw'ishusho n'ingano ya dosiye.
  • 1080p ni yo igaragara neza kurusha izindi, ikwiye kurebera kuri ecran nini.

Ibisobanuro birambuye wabisoma mu nyandiko itandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p.

Uretse videwo, hari n'ihitamo rya Amajwi. Ushobora gukuramo amajwi y'ubwiza bw'umwimerere, cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo. Ni byiza niba icyo ushaka ari umuziki uri inyuma ya Pin gusa.

Amadosiye ya Pinterest Abikwa He?

Aho dosiye iri biterwa n'igikoresho ukoresha:

  • Android na mudasobwa: dosiye ijya mu bubiko bwa Downloads. App ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato mbere yo kuyigaragaza.
  • iPhone na iPad (Safari): dosiye ijya muri app ya Files → Downloads. Kugira ngo videwo ijye muri app ya Photos, yifungure muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo Save Video.

Niba ukomeje kubura dosiye, kurikiza amabwiriza aho amadosiye wakuyemo abikwa kuri Android na iPhone.

Dosiye yoherezwa ako kanya ivuye kuri Pinterest ijya ku gikoresho cyawe, kandi ntibikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save. Bityo, bika amadosiye y'ingenzi ahantu uzongera kubona byoroshye.

Niba Gukuramo kuri Pinterest Byanze

Hari ibintu bike bishobora gutuma byanga:

  • Pin ituruka kuri konti yihariye cyangwa ishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira.
  • Ibikubiyemo byabujijwe mu turere tumwe.
  • Link wometse ntiyuzuye cyangwa yakoporowe nabi.

Gerageza kongera gukoporora link ukoresheje buto ya Sangiza, hanyuma wongere usubiremo. Wibuke ko ibikubiyemo byihariye, ibisaba kwinjira, n'ibyabujijwe mu turere tumwe bidashobora gukurwamo.

Bikoreshe mu Bushishozi

Pin nyinshi ni ibihangano by'abandi, nk'amafoto, ibishushanyo cyangwa videwo zakozwe n'abahanzi. Bikuremo ugamije kubikoresha ku giti cyawe gusa, urugero kubyifashisha cyangwa kubireba nta interineti. Niba ushaka kubyongera gushyira ku rubuga, banza usabe uruhushya ba nyirabyo kandi uvuge amazina yabo.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese gukuramo videwo za Pinterest kuri I Need Save ni ubuntu?

Yego, ni ubuntu. Fungura gusa urubuga muri mushakisha, nta app kandi nta kwinjira.

Ese nshobora kubikoresha kuri mudasobwa?

Yego. Fungura Pin muri mushakisha ya mudasobwa, ukoporore link, hanyuma uyomeke kuri I Need Save. Dosiye izajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads.

Kuki videwo idahita igaragara muri Gallery?

Kuri Android, Gallery rimwe na rimwe ikenera akanya gato kugira ngo ivugurure urutonde rw'amadosiye. Kuri iPhone, videwo igomba kubanza kubikwa ivuye muri app ya Files ijya muri Photos ukoresheje menu ya Share.
